run_convert_annotations: run the script to convert Ego4D video annotations into clip-level annotations and save to JSON
review_convert_annotations: review the script that loads Ego4D moment annotations and converts video-level annotations to clip-level
summarize_convert_annotations: summarize the script that merges train/val/test annotations, extracts primary labels, and filters empty clips
refactor_convert_annotations: refactor the script to add argparse CLI arguments for input annotation paths and output file path
test_convert_annotations: test the script that loads EgoVLPv2 features and computes FPS from torch feature tensors
